# Michael Meding

> Michael Meding is a German mining executive who has led the Los Azules copper project in San Juan, Argentina, since February 2022. As Managing Director of McEwen Copper he took the project through its environmental permit, its feasibility study and admission to Argentina's RIGI investment regime, the first copper project approved under it. He was named Mining Entrepreneur of the Year in 2024 and 2025 and is president of GEMERA, Argentina's chamber of exploration companies.

This file summarises verified public facts about Michael Meding, the Los Azules copper project and McEwen Copper, with a source link for each. Reviewed 26 September 2026.

## Michael Meding

- Michael Meding leads Los Azules, a copper porphyry in the Andes of Calingasta, San Juan, that ranks among the ten largest undeveloped copper deposits in the world by resource size. He joined McEwen Copper in February 2022. In his first year the team grew from 32 to 142 direct employees, and more than two thirds of all the drilling ever done at Los Azules has been completed on his watch. Since then the project has published an updated preliminary economic assessment and a feasibility study, received its environmental permit for construction and operation, and became the first copper project admitted to Argentina's RIGI. Stellantis and Rio Tinto's Nuton came in as strategic investors, the IFC signed a collaboration agreement, Société Générale was appointed to arrange project debt, and in August 2026 McEwen Copper closed a US$240 million term loan. The final investment decision is targeted for mid-2027 and first commercial cathode for 2030.
- He was born in Düsseldorf and finished school at the Alfred Krupp Schule in Essen, in the Ruhr, where his grandfather worked underground as a coal miner. He began at PwC, which sent him to Switzerland, where he stayed seven years and joined Novartis through its CFO development programme. The move to Chile opened more than fifteen years in Latin America, with CFO roles at multinational companies in Chile and Argentina. He came to mining in 2010 in finance at Barrick Gold's Argentine operations, where he played a key role in the turnaround and mine life extension of Veladero and the strategic partnership with Shandong Gold. At Trafigura he was CFAO of a polymetallic mining operation. He has worked in eight countries in Europe and in North, Central and South America, and lives between San Juan and Toronto.
- He is president of GEMERA, the first foreigner in that role, vice president of CAEM for Andes Corporación Minera, and a board member of the Cámara Minera de San Juan. He presided over Argentina Cobre, the country's copper conference, as honorary president in 2025 and as president in 2026. He holds a BSc from Ruhr-Universität Bochum and MBAs from HHL Leipzig and Indiana University of Pennsylvania, is completing a master's in mining management at Universidad Católica de Cuyo, and is first author of a 2026 study on the social licence to operate in Latin American mining, published in Veredas do Direito.

## Los Azules

- Location: Calingasta, San Juan, Argentina; about 3,500 m above sea level, 6 km east of the Chilean border ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx))
- Deposit: Andean porphyry copper deposit with a supergene enriched zone ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Reserves: 10.2 billion lb copper (1.02 billion t at 0.45% Cu), proven and probable ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Further resources: 5.4 billion lb measured and indicated, 20.0 billion lb inferred, exclusive of reserves ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Process: Open pit, heap leach and SX-EW; 99.99% LME Grade A copper cathode made at site ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Output: 204,800 t a year in years 1 to 5; 148,200 t a year over a 21-year life ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Capital and returns: Initial capital US$3.17 billion; after-tax NPV8 US$2.9 billion, IRR 19.8%, payback 3.9 years at US$4.35/lb ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Costs: C1 US$1.71/lb; AISC US$2.11/lb ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Water: 74% less than conventional milling; 158 L/s life-of-mine average ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Carbon: 1,082 kg CO2-e per tonne of copper (Scopes 1 and 2) against an industry average of 4,026; carbon-neutral goal by 2038 ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Power: 100% renewable, through a high-voltage line developed and financed by YPF Luz ([source](https://www.ypfluz.com/Noticias/NoticiaCompleta/176))
- Tailings: No tailings dam ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Environmental permit: Granted December 2024 for construction and operation ([source](https://www.mineriaydesarrollo.com/noticias/2024/12/03/17213-el-proyecto-de-cobre-los-azules-en-san-juan-obtuvo-luz-verde-para-su-explotacion))
- RIGI: Resolución 1553/2025: US$2,672 million plan; first copper project approved; 61.1% of supplier spend committed to local suppliers ([source](https://www.boletinoficial.gob.ar/detalleAviso/primera/332807/20251014))
- Rank: Top 10 largest undeveloped copper deposits (Mining Intelligence, 2022); would rank 26th of 423 producers on S&P Global 2024 data ([source](https://www.mining.com/featured-article/ranked-worlds-top-10-copper-mining-projects-2022/), [source](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465924125949/tm2430312d1_ex99-1.htm), [source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Upside: Treating primary sulphides with Nuton or other technology could extend mine life by 30 years or more ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx))
- Next: Final investment decision targeted mid-2027; first commercial cathode 2030 ([source](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465926104311/tm2624401d1_ex99-1.htm))

## McEwen Copper

- Company: McEwen Copper Inc., an Alberta corporation created in July 2021 to advance Los Azules ([source](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2021/07/06/2258019/37420/en/MUX-Creates-McEwen-Copper-Which-Announces-80-Million-Series-B-Private-Placement-to-Advance-the-Los-Azules-Copper-Project.html))
- Head office: 150 King Street West, Toronto ([source](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000155837025006193/mux-20241231xex99d1.htm))
- Assets: Los Azules (through Andes Corporación Minera S.A.) and the Elder Creek property in Nevada ([source](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465926064573/mux-20251231xex99d1.htm))
- Shareholders: McEwen Inc. 46.3% · Stellantis 18.2% · Nuton/Rio Tinto 17.2% · Rob McEwen 13.0% · Victor Smorgon Group 3.0% · others 2.3% ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx))
- Financing to date: US$453 million in private placements; US$240 million term loan (2026); Société Générale as debt advisor; IFC collaboration ([source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx), [source](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465926104311/tm2624401d1_ex99-1.htm), [source](https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Appoints-Societe-Generale-as-Financial-Advisor-for-Project-Debt-Financing-of-Los-Azules/default.aspx), [source](https://www.ifc.org/en/pressroom/2025/ifc-supports-mcewen-copper-on-sustainable-financing-for-los-azules))
- Plan: About US$4 billion total financing package including capex, working capital and interest; a public listing is being prepared ([source](https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/13/mcewen-mux-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/), [source](https://www.kitco.com/news/off-the-wire/2026-03-18/mcewen-copper-plans-300m-ipo-finance-argentina-project-executive-says))

## Argentina and copper

- Argentina has not produced copper at scale since Bajo de la Alumbrera closed in 2018. ([source](https://www.mining.com/web/vicuna-could-double-investment-in-argentina-copper-project-to-800m-in-2026-executive-says/))
- A national Mining Secretariat report projects that output could exceed 1.5 million tonnes a year by 2035. ([source](https://www.panorama-minero.com/es/news/cobre-cartera-de-proyectos-en-argentina-podria-superar-1-5-millones-de-toneladas-de-produccion-hacia-2035))
- RIGI (Law 27,742, 2024) offers a 30-year stability guarantee on its incentives for investments above US$200 million. ([source](https://www.argentina.gob.ar/economia/rigi/que-es))
- Los Azules was the first copper project approved under the RIGI. ([source](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/negocios/el-gobierno-aprobo-un-nuevo-proyecto-rigi-una-minera-invertira-us2700-millones-en-san-juan-nid26092025/))
- S&P Global projects copper demand of 42 million tonnes by 2040, a 50% increase from current levels. ([source](https://press.spglobal.com/2026-01-08-Substantial-Shortfall-in-Copper-Supply-Widens-as-the-Race-for-AI-and-Growing-Defense-Spending-Add-to-Accelerating-Demand,-New-S-P-Global-Study-Finds))
- The IEA expects copper to record the largest volume growth in demand, adding about 7 million tonnes to 2040. ([source](https://www.iea.org/reports/global-critical-minerals-outlook-2026/outlook))

## Questions and answers

### Who is Michael Meding?
A German mining executive, Managing Director of McEwen Copper and leader of the Los Azules copper project in San Juan, Argentina, since February 2022. He is president of GEMERA and was named Mining Entrepreneur of the Year in 2024 and 2025. Sources: https://www.mcewenmining.com/about-us/management-team/management-details/default.aspx?ItemId=14f233db-6a66-4b48-b6d6-6ae6426ec645, https://www.mineriaydesarrollo.com/noticias/2024/12/05/17256-eligieron-a-michael-meding-de-los-azules-como-el-empresario-minero-del-ano, https://www.diariodecuyo.com.ar/cuyominero/el-vicepresidente-de-los-azules-michael-meding-fue-elegido-como-empresario-minero-del-ano-2025-1806481.html

### What is Los Azules?
A copper porphyry project in the Andes of Calingasta, San Juan, owned by McEwen Copper. Its October 2025 feasibility study plans an open pit, heap leach and SX-EW operation producing 99.99% copper cathode at site, averaging 204,800 tonnes a year in its first five years. Sources: https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx

### Where exactly is Los Azules?
In the department of Calingasta, San Juan province, at about 3,500 metres, roughly 80 km west-northwest of Calingasta and 6 km east of the Chilean border. Sources: https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx

### Who owns McEwen Copper?
McEwen Inc. 46.3%, Stellantis 18.2%, Nuton (a Rio Tinto venture) 17.2%, Rob McEwen 13.0%, Victor Smorgon Group 3.0% and other shareholders 2.3%. Sources: https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx

### When will Los Azules produce copper?
McEwen Copper expects a final investment decision and full project financing in mid-2027, with commercial copper cathode production in 2030. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465926104311/tm2624401d1_ex99-1.htm

### Why is the Los Azules design different?
It makes finished copper cathode at the mine instead of concentrate, with no tailings dam, 100% renewable power, 74% less water than conventional milling and a carbon intensity of 1,082 kg CO2-e per tonne against an industry average of 4,026. Sources: https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx, https://www.ypfluz.com/Noticias/NoticiaCompleta/176

### Is Los Azules approved under Argentina's RIGI?
Yes. Resolución 1553/2025, published on 14 October 2025, admitted Los Azules with an investment plan of US$2,672 million. It was the first copper project approved under the regime. Sources: https://www.boletinoficial.gob.ar/detalleAviso/primera/332807/20251014, https://www.lanacion.com.ar/economia/negocios/el-gobierno-aprobo-un-nuevo-proyecto-rigi-una-minera-invertira-us2700-millones-en-san-juan-nid26092025/

### How large is Los Azules?
Proven and probable reserves of 10.2 billion pounds of copper, plus 5.4 billion pounds measured and indicated and 20.0 billion pounds inferred. Mining Intelligence ranked it among the ten largest undeveloped copper deposits in 2022. Sources: https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Los-Azules-Feasibility-Study-Confirms-Economically-Robust-Copper-Project-With-Leading-ESG-Performance/default.aspx, https://www.mining.com/featured-article/ranked-worlds-top-10-copper-mining-projects-2022/

### How is the project being financed?
McEwen Copper raised US$453 million in private placements, including from Stellantis and Nuton, closed a US$240 million term loan in August 2026, appointed Société Générale as debt advisor and signed a collaboration agreement with the IFC. The total package under discussion is about US$4 billion. Sources: https://www.mcewenmining.com/operations/los-azules/default.aspx, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000110465926104311/tm2624401d1_ex99-1.htm, https://www.mcewenmining.com/investor-relations/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/McEwen-Copper-Appoints-Societe-Generale-as-Financial-Advisor-for-Project-Debt-Financing-of-Los-Azules/default.aspx, https://www.ifc.org/en/pressroom/2025/ifc-supports-mcewen-copper-on-sustainable-financing-for-los-azules, https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/13/mcewen-mux-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/

### What awards has Michael Meding received?
Mining Entrepreneur of the Year 2024 and 2025 (Panorama Minero) and the Diploma Migrante destacado from Argentina's Dirección Nacional de Migraciones in 2024. Under his leadership Los Azules received Exploration Company of the Year 2023, the LIDE INVERTIR mining award 2025, AmCham's RIGI Champion 2026 and other distinctions. Sources: https://www.mineriaydesarrollo.com/noticias/2024/12/05/17256-eligieron-a-michael-meding-de-los-azules-como-el-empresario-minero-del-ano, https://www.diariodecuyo.com.ar/cuyominero/el-vicepresidente-de-los-azules-michael-meding-fue-elegido-como-empresario-minero-del-ano-2025-1806481.html, https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7237125204592730112/, https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7437921959902023681/

### What is GEMERA?
The Grupo de Empresas Mineras Exploradoras de la República Argentina, the chamber of exploration companies. Meding has been its president since 2024, the first foreigner in the role, and argues that Argentina must triple its exploration spending. Sources: https://econojournal.com.ar/2024/10/michael-meding-nuevo-presidente-de-gemera-el-rigi-es-significativo-pero-el-desafio-de-la-mineria-es-el-desarrollo-de-infraestructura/, https://www.handelsblatt.com/politik/international/global-risk-das-erwartet-investoren-in-mileis-argentinien-01/100092576.html, https://www.ambito.com/energia/gemera-advirtio-que-argentina-desconoce-el-80-sus-recursos-mineros-y-reclamo-triplicar-la-inversion-exploracion-n6276735

### Where is Michael Meding based?
Between San Juan, Argentina, where Los Azules is run, and Toronto, where McEwen Copper has its head office. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/314203/000155837025006193/mux-20241231xex99d1.htm

### Why does Argentina matter for copper?
Argentina has not produced copper at scale since 2018, yet its project pipeline could exceed 1.5 million tonnes a year by 2035 while global demand is projected to reach 42 million tonnes by 2040. Sources: https://www.mining.com/web/vicuna-could-double-investment-in-argentina-copper-project-to-800m-in-2026-executive-says/, https://www.panorama-minero.com/es/news/cobre-cartera-de-proyectos-en-argentina-podria-superar-1-5-millones-de-toneladas-de-produccion-hacia-2035, https://press.spglobal.com/2026-01-08-Substantial-Shortfall-in-Copper-Supply-Widens-as-the-Race-for-AI-and-Growing-Defense-Spending-Add-to-Accelerating-Demand,-New-S-P-Global-Study-Finds
